label: Rival: every actual concrete being is NECESSARY_2 (concrete necessitarianism)
paraphrase: Rival (concrete necessitarianism, the modal-collapse family #462/#555), analyst formulation: every concrete individual existing at w exists at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2, NecessaryAt, the route frame's box of existence). It makes the route's grounding premise STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT vacuously true (CONTINGENT-NODE-CONTROLS, Scope), so it is a rival of the contingency node, not of that premise.
